waste.t: You often made more than you sold.

stockout.t: You often ran out of stock and missed sales.

overstock.t: Unsold stock tied up your cash.

capacity.t: Customers were turned away because you lacked capacity.

lowRunway.t: Your cash ran low, with less than three months of runway.

lowMargin.t: Your price barely covered the cost of each sale.

foodcost.t: Ingredient costs were above the usual 25–35% of sales.

labour.t: Wages were a high share of sales.

ltv.t: Customers were worth less than they cost to win.

churn.t: Too many customers cancelled each month.

overload.t: Your team was overloaded, which hurt quality.

ar.t: Unpaid invoices left you short of cash.

dilution.t: You gave away more than half the company.

debt.t: Loan repayments took a large share of your sales.

rival.t: Your rival won customers on price.
